Name of Test Case: Filter news feed by kind: Updates vs Articles
Expected Outcome: News feed filters to display only short announcement updates; longer articles are hidden.

Name of Test Case: Filter news posts by category tag pill
Action to Take: Click category pill 'Outreach' in tag suggestions bar.
Expected Outcome: Displays only posts tagged with the 'Outreach' category.

Name of Test Case: Expand long-form article to read full text
Action to Take: Click 'Read the full article' button on an article exceeding 420 characters.
Expected Outcome: Article expands smoothly revealing full body paragraphs and hides the expand button.

Name of Test Case: Verify AI 3-bullet summary on featured articles
Action to Take: Inspect header of a featured pastor article.
Expected Outcome: Displays AI bullet summary section containing 3 concise takeaway bullet points.

Name of Test Case: Click internal action link on quick update post
Action to Take: Click 'Find a place to serve' button on volunteer announcement update.
Expected Outcome: Executes in-app routing to '#/serve/find' without triggering full page reload.

Name of Test Case: Open external reference link in new browser tab
Action to Take: Click 'Learn more' external web link on community partner update.
Expected Outcome: Opens external URL in a new browser tab with rel='noopener noreferrer'.

Name of Test Case: Staff opens 'Write a post' modal and creates new article
Action to Take: Sign in as staff, click '+ Write a post', enter title 'Fall Outreach Kickoff', select kind 'article', write body, and click Publish.
Expected Outcome: Calls POST /blog; article is saved and immediately appears at the top of the news feed.

Action to Take: Click 'Delete post' trash button on an expired announcement as staff.
Expected Outcome: Calls DELETE /blog/:id; post is removed from news listing.

Name of Test Case: Article AI summary generation on non-standard formatting
Action to Take: Staff publishes an article containing unusual ASCII formatting or markdown bullet lists.
Expected Outcome: AI summarizes article into 3 clean bullet points.

Name of Test Case: Pagination / infinite scroll on large archive of news posts
Action to Take: Scroll to bottom of news feed containing 50+ published posts.
Expected Outcome: Pagination or infinite scroll loads older posts in manageable batches.
